topic: Theory: Akainu won chapter 573 by attacking Ace's pride, not his strength
title: Akainu Never Beat Ace, He Baited Him
description: Akainu didn't win a fair fight in chapter 573. He insulted Whitebeard and Ace did the rest. The full What If is on the channel: what if Ace had kept running? Was it a trap or just Ace's pride?
comment: Was Ace's death Akainu's trap, or just Ace being Ace? Pick one.

lines.text: Akainu didn't beat Ace in chapter 573. He baited him.

shot.fallback: anime style dramatic pirate scene, no text

lines.text: Ace was free. He was running toward the ships with Luffy beside him.

shot.fallback: anime style dramatic pirate scene, no text

lines.text: Whitebeard had just ordered every man to live and return to the New World.

shot.fallback: anime style dramatic pirate scene, no text

lines.text: Then Akainu called Whitebeard a failure who never beat Roger or became Pirate King.

shot.fallback: anime style dramatic pirate scene, no text

lines.text: Ace stopped. He turned around. That is the whole trap.

shot.fallback: anime style dramatic pirate scene, no text

lines.text: People say that was just Ace's pride. And yes, that is the steelman.

shot.fallback: anime style dramatic pirate scene, no text

lines.text: But look at who Akainu picked. A magma user against a fire user.

shot.fallback: anime style dramatic pirate scene, no text

lines.text: He knew Ace's fire was the weaker element, and he knew exactly which insult would make Ace use it.

shot.fallback: anime style dramatic pirate scene, no text

lines.text: Then he went for Luffy, and Ace took the hit that was meant for his brother.

shot.fallback: anime style dramatic pirate scene, no text

lines.text: So Akainu never needed to out-fight Ace. He only needed one sentence.

shot.fallback: anime style dramatic pirate scene, no text

lines.text: If Ace had ignored that insult, I think he lives, and Whitebeard's last order wins.

shot.fallback: anime style dramatic pirate scene, no text

lines.text: That is why I'll say it again: Akainu didn't beat Ace in chapter 573.

shot.fallback: anime style dramatic pirate scene, no text
